answer_1.quote: In order to develop personalized dialogue agents ... generate personalized responses. ... The goal of the personalized dialogue is to generate a personalized response R_i using the corresponding personal information P_i in text form.

answer_2.quote: We divide the automatic evaluation methods into three categories ... (1) Diversity Distinct-1/2 ... (2) Consistency ... Con.Score ... (3) Coherence BLEU-1 and ROUGE-L ... we also propose C-Dist-1/2, S-Dist-1/2, Coh-Con.Score.

answer_4.quote: We perform human evaluations of all models, and we convert the scoring method to a ranking method. Specifically, we extract 100 data points ... hire three well-educated annotators to score the responses generated by the different models in a ranking style ... We focus on four aspects: readability, diversity, consistency, and coherence.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rank the generated responses according to readability, diversity, consistency, and coherence.
